name: Gitea
description: Gitea is a painless self-hosted Git service. It is a community-managed fork of Gogs, written in Go and licensed under the MIT license. It runs light on resources and includes issue tracking, pull requests, wikis, and integrations. Note: This is a third-party community template and is not an official XML file from the application developers.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Persistent storage path for configurations, databases, keys, and git repositories.

ports.name: SSH Port
ports.description: SSH port for git operations. Unraid host port 22 is usually reserved, so 2222 is recommended.

variables.name: User UID
variables.description: UID of the user running Gitea (Unraid default 'nobody' user is 99).

variables.name: User GID
variables.description: GID of the group running Gitea (Unraid default 'users' group is 100).
